definitions.explanation: The fluctuation between cold and warm temperatures.

examples.japanese: {寒暖|かんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
⟦{寒暖|かんだん}{計|けい}→寒暖計：15402_kandankei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: To measure the temperature with a thermometer.
Spring is a season with large temperature differences.

notes:
{寒暖|かんだん} combines {寒|かん} (cold) + {暖|だん} (warm) to describe the contrast between cold and warm temperatures.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {寒暖|かんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: temperature difference/variation
- {寒暖|かんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: extreme temperature variation
- ⟦{寒暖|かんだん}{計|けい}→寒暖計：15402_kandankei⟧: thermometer
- {寒暖|かんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: large temperature difference

USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the phrase {寒暖|かんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧. Used when talking about weather, seasonal changes, and health. Large {寒暖|かんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ is often cited as a cause of ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧ or discomfort.

SEASONAL CONTEXT:
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ and ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧ are known for significant {寒暖|かんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧
- ⟦{朝晩|あさばん}→朝晩：28955_asaban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寒暖|かんだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: morning-evening temperature difference

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧: air temperature
- ⟦{温度差|おんどさ}→温度差：28956_ondosa⟧: temperature difference (more general)
